title: Sendwise — Send Money
objective: You have two accounts and a limited balance. Make the system hold more money than it was given.

verifier.condition: The total balance across all accounts is greater than the money originally in the system.

weakness: The transfer endpoint credits the recipient first and debits the sender second; when the debit is refused for insufficient funds the request returns 402 but the credit is never reversed, so money is created.
seededData: Accounts alice ($100.00), bob ($20.00) and carol ($50.00). In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Transfers are more than one step. Try one that should fail and look at the balances afterwards — on both accounts.
A failure that comes after a step has already happened needs that step undone. Does it get undone?
Send more than your balance to your other account. The request fails; then check the recipient's balance.
burpNotes: Check both accounts' balances before and after each request, including the failed ones.
